### The Goal
I wanted to see if we could quantify the emotional highs and lows across different books of the Bible using Natural Language Processing (NLTK) and pandas. 

### The Approach
Instead of showing all the messy data cleaning, here is the core function that actually calculates the sentiment score for a given verse:

```python
from nltk.sentiment import SentimentIntensityAnalyzer

def get_verse_sentiment(text):
    sia = SentimentIntensityAnalyzer()
    return sia.polarity_scores(text)['compound']
```
